_how_to_add: One entry per formal partner (agreed to be listed). 'category' must match a category id in resources.json (football, education, career, wellbeing, transition). Put the logo in assets/img/partners/ (transparent PNG, about 240px tall). Every partner also appears in the logo strip above the footer on every page. Run python3 _build.py after editing.

partners.name: FC Ogden
partners.tagline: A professional club built from the ground up, for Ogden.
story: FC Ogden is building Ogden’s professional soccer club from the ground up. The club kicks off in UPSL Division 1 in spring 2028 and plans to earn its way up from there.
It is run for the community. FC Ogden keeps its books open to the public and never charges players to play.
For players finishing college soccer, that makes it a real place to keep competing in Northern Utah. The 91st and FC Ogden work together to connect those players with the club.

contact.name: Derick Turner
contact.note: Finishing college soccer and want to keep playing in Northern Utah? Reach out to Derick directly.
contact.subject: Interested in FC Ogden (via The 91st)
